items.text: The page title names both the acronym and the full organization name, joined by an en dash

items.text: A single system-ui font stack is used for every measured element, with no web fonts loaded

items.text: h2 headings are 24px bold, a big step down from the 44px h1

items.text: Green is the only accent. Links, the Switchto.ng button, the Subscribe button and the calendar nav links all use the same green (11,107,58), and no secondary hue appears in the UI chrome.
items.evidence: top_text_colors includes rgb(11,107,58) x25; screenshot links and buttons

items.text: Buttons share one visual language. The primary and secondary CTAs and the Switchto.ng and Subscribe buttons are solid or outlined with bold white or green text, small-to-medium radii (about 4–6px), and generous padding.
items.evidence: Screenshot hero buttons, Switchto.ng, Subscribe; border_radius_buckets bucket_1_7: 55

items.text: Spacing is generous. The hero is about 500px tall, cards have about 24px of inner padding and gaps of about 20px, and the footer has a large amount of padding.
items.evidence: Hero y143–640; card gaps ~20px in screenshot; top_backgrounds

features.statement: Page title pairs an acronym with the full organization name, joined by an en dash
A single system-ui font stack is used throughout, with no web fonts loaded
h2 headings are bold 24px, a large step down from a much larger h1
Heading outline skips levels: card and sidebar widget titles use h3 with few or no h2 parents
Body text is near-black with a green-gray cast; secondary text is muted gray-green
A single green accent is used for links, buttons and nav links, with no secondary hue
A thin dark utility bar at the top holds social text links on one side and contact details on the other
White header pairs a logo image with a text lockup of acronym and full name
Primary navigation is a row of plain text items with a filled accent button that wraps to a second row
Hero uses the page's only gradient, a diagonal dark-to-lighter green background
Hero copy is formal, institutional language describing the organization's role and status
Main area is a two-column layout with a wide content column and a narrower right sidebar
Content cards are arranged in rows: a pair of feature cards above a row of three link-list cards
Cards are white with thin light borders and rounded corners, with no shadows
Small icons render at inline sizes beside card text, with some distorted aspect ratios
Links are green and not underlined, including inline 'Read More' links at paragraph ends
Link lists are vertical with thin horizontal dividers between items
Newsletter signup is a single email input with a solid accent button stacked below
Dark green footer repeats social links as small circular colorful raster icons after a bold label
Page uses landmark and section elements but no article or figure elements
No transitions, animations, transforms or blur effects are used
Styling comes from one inline style block with few semantic class names rather than utility classes
Corner radii are small (mostly square or 1–7px), with none above 15px except pills
Page has minimal metadata: no structured data and only charset, viewport and description meta tags
Page is link-dense, with many anchors and list items relative to little text
Buttons share one visual language: solid or outlined, bold text, small radii and generous padding
Spacing is generous: tall hero, roughly 24px card padding, about 20px gaps and a padded footer
